description.en: Whenever an ally is summoned, if it is on or adjacent to a Storm Cloud, the summon consumes it, and gains the Electric modifier.
Whenever an ally is summoned, if it is on or adjacent to a Blizzard, the summon consumes it, and gains the Frostspew modifier.
Whenever an ally is summoned, if it is on or adjacent to a Chasm, the summon consumes it, and gains the Ghostly modifier.
Whenever an ally is summoned, if it is on or adjacent to a Wall, the summon consumes it, and gains the Clay modifier.
Whenever an enemy unit takes [Ice] or [Lightning] damage, it gets -25 [Ice] and [Lightning] resist.  This debuff does not stack.
Whenever an enemy unit takes [Dark] or [Arcane] damage, it gets -25 [Dark] and [Arcane] resist.  This debuff does not stack.
Whenever an enemy unit takes [Fire] or [Lightning] damage, it gets -25 [Fire] and [Lightning] resist.  This debuff does not stack.
Whenever an enemy unit takes [Dark] or [Holy] damage, it gets -25 [Dark] and [Holy] resist.  This debuff does not stack.
Whenever an enemy unit takes [Ice] or [Arcane] damage, it gets -25 [Ice] and [Arcane] resist.  This debuff does not stack.
Whenever an enemy unit takes [Fire] or [Holy] damage, it gets -25 [Fire] and [Holy] resist.  This debuff does not stack.
Redeal half of all damage you deal with [sorcery] as [arcane] damage.
Redeal half of all damage you deal with [enchantments:enchantment] as [fire] damage.

Whenever you cast a level 1 or 2 [nature] spell, summon a spriggan.
Whenever you cast a level 3 or higher [nature] spell, summon a treant.

Whenever you cast a level 1 or 2 [arcane] spell, summon a boggart.
Whenever you cast a level 3 or higher [arcane] spell, summon a phase spider.

Whenever you cast a level 1 or 2 [dark] spell, summon a fly swarm.
Whenever you cast a level 3 or higher [dark] spell, summon a bag of bugs.
Whenever a minion you control deals damage to an enemy, redeal half that much damage as [fire] damage.
Whenever a minion you control deals damage to an enemy, redeal half that much damage as [ice] damage.
For every 50 damage dealt to enemies by [enchantments:enchantment], summon 3 Troublers for 7 turns.
When you cast a level 4 or lower [sorcery] spell, your [dragon] allies with matching types will attempt to cast that spell also.
Deals 2 [physical], 2 [fire], and 2 [lightning] damage to units before they would be damaged by your [sorcery] spells.
When you or one of your [living] or [holy] allies takes damage from an enemy, this staff deals 7 [holy] damage to the source of that damage.
For every 50 damage dealt to enemies with Holy spells, cast Immolate on a random enemy
For every 60 damage dealt to enemies with Fire spells, cast Mercurize on a random enemy
For every 75 damage dealt to enemies with Sorcery spells, cast Death Chill on a random enemy
For every 40 damage dealt to enemies with Lightning spells, cast Annihilate on a random enemy
For every 50 damage dealt to enemies with Enchantment spells, cast Blazerip on a random enemy
For every 40 damage dealt to enemies with Arcane spells, cast Heavenly Blast on a random enemy
For every 50 damage dealt to enemies with Enchantment spells, cast Lightning Bolt on a random enemy
For every 30 damage dealt to enemies with Ice spells, cast Poison Sting on a random enemy
For every 30 damage dealt to enemies with Blood spells, cast Scourge on a random enemy
Whenever an enemy dies, summon a Fire Bomber where it was
Whenever an enemy dies, summon a Fire Fly Swarm where it was
Whenever an enemy dies, summon a Mantis where it was
Whenever an enemy dies, summon a Spriggan where it was
Whenever an enemy dies, summon a random imp where it was for 5 turns
Creates a Rift at the wizard's location upon level victory.
Whenever an enemy takes [dark] damage, deal that much [lightning] damage to up to 3 units in a 3 tile burst.
Whenever an enemy takes [ice] and [dark] damage in the same turn, summon a spirit of sorrow near that enemy for 10 turns.
Whenever a glassified enemy takes physical damage, it is unglassified and a glass faery is summoned.
Whenever a [living] ally deals damage to an enemy, if that enemy is in your line of sight, deal 8 [physical] damage to that enemy.
Whenever [poison] is inflicted on an unpoisoned enemy, they are berserked for three turns.
Whenever you cast a spell, if your most recently cast spell was exactly one level lower, casts a random known cantrip on one random enemy in your line of sight.
All spells and skills gain +1 damage for each unique tag amongst all the spells you have cast this level.
Each turn, all soaked enemies take [25_fire:fire] damage.
When you deal damage with an [eye] spell, deal that much damage again but in a beam to the target, destroying walls and clouds in the way.
Whenever an enemy takes [ice] or [lightning] damage, gain 1 SH up to a max of 1
Gain 1 SH each turn, up to a maximum of 1
Whenever a [Living] unit dies, gain 5 HP
Whenever a [living] unit dies, gain 1 SH, up to a max of 2
On taking damage from another unit, the source is petrified for 1 turn
Regenerate 1 HP each turn
Regenerate 1 HP each turn
Whenever you cast a [Dark] or [Holy] spell, deal 8 [Dark] to a random enemy in line of sight, and 8 [Holy] damage to another.
Whenever you cast a [Lightning] or [Dark] spell, deal 8 [Lightning] to a random enemy in line of sight, and 8 [Dark] damage to another.
Whenever you cast a [Fire] or [Ice] spell, deal 8 [Fire] to a random enemy in line of sight, and 8 [Ice] damage to another.
Whenever you cast a [Arcane] or [Ice] spell, deal 8 [Arcane] to a random enemy in line of sight, and 8 [Ice] damage to another.

Spawn a slime of a matching type when you take damage from an enemy.
If there is no slime which matches the damage type, spawns a random slime
If you would take damage, deal that much damage to an adjacent slime ally instead.
Each turn, soaked enemies in a 5 tile radius are [frozen] for 3 turns.
When a [Dragon] ally dies, gain 10% resistance to damage types matching their tags until the end of the realm.
Upon taking damage, gain 1 SH
Whenever a [living] ally dies, a random wounded ally up to 3 tiles away receives healing equal to the dead ally's max hp.
Each turn, all allied units heal for 1 hp per 100 damage dealt to enemies by allied units.
Whenever you cast an [ice] spell, deal 2 [ice] damage to all enemy units in line of sight of the target
Each turn, petrify a random unpetrified enemy in line of sight for 3 turns
Whenever you cast an [eye] spell, gain 3 SH, up to a maximum of 20.
Your [Enchantment] spells gain quickcast (the first one cast each turn does not conclude the turn).
Nine turns after you enter a realm, cast Earthquake, Flameburst, Stormburst, and Word of Chaos
When a [living] or [slime] ally deals damage to an enemy, they gain 1 max HP
Whenever you cast a [Fire] spell, your [Fire] spells and skills gain [2_damage:damage] for [6_turns:duration]
Whenever you cast a [Ice] spell, your [Ice] spells and skills gain [2_damage:damage] for [6_turns:duration]
Whenever you cast a [Arcane] spell, your [Arcane] spells and skills gain [2_damage:damage] for [6_turns:duration]
After 25 turns, summon 11 Fire Fly Swarms and 4 Fire Spirits.
After 25 turns, summon 2 Yetis and 3 Storm Spirits.
After 25 turns, summon 7 Gnomes and 2 Mycobeasts.
After 25 turns, summon 7 Ravens and 4 Witchs.
On spending HP to cast a [blood] spell, deal that much [physical] damage to up to 3 enemies in line of sight.
Each turn, one of your Dragon minions instantly casts Annihilate on a random enemy.
Each turn, one of your Undead minions instantly casts Touch of Death on a random enemy.
Each turn, one of your Holy minions instantly casts Void Beam on a random enemy.
Whenever an allied dragon dies, it spawns a two headed flametouched, stormtouched, chaos touched, or metallic snake.
Each level, when you cast your seventh unique spell, summon 7 duergar.

When an enemy receives a debuff, there is a 50% chance they will receive another random debuff for the same duration up to a maximum of 10 turns.
This item can apply any of the following:
Blind, Poison, Frozen, Petrified, Feared, Silenced
At the end of your turn, increase the duration of debuffs on enemies in a 3 tile radius by 1.

Gain clarity when you cast a [translocation] spell.
The buff's duration is equal to the spell's level.
Gain 2 HP each turn unless you moved
Every 7 steps, regain a charge of each level 1 spell you know
Upon entering a level, all enemies are stunned for 1 turns
Grants Burrowing
Grants Flying
Upon entering a rift, cast your [Seal:dark] [Fate:dark] on all enemies within the spell's range.
Upon entering a rift, immediately cast your [Heavenly_Blast:holy] on all demons and undead in line of sight.
Whenever you take a step, you gain 1 SH
Whenever a unit is frozen, you heal for 2 HP
Every 6 steps, summon a Gnome
Every 4 steps, summon a Green Slime
Every 3 steps, summon a Kobold
Every 8 steps, summon a Ogre
Every 3 steps, summon a Ghost

Every 15 steps, casts your Storm Burst spell.
15 steps until cast.

Every 15 steps, casts your Flame Burst spell.
15 steps until cast.

Every 8 steps, casts your Earthquake spell.
8 steps until cast.
Whenever you pick up an SP orb, your Holy spells regain all charges.
Whenever you pick up an SP orb, your Metallic spells regain all charges.
Whenever you pick up an SP orb, your Translocation spells regain all charges.
Whenever you pick up an SP orb, your Dragon spells regain all charges.

When you complete a level, permanently sacrifice 25 HP to activate the Codex.
When you activate the Codex, learn a [word] spell. 
If you know every available [word] spell, this item ceases to function.
Restores all life and protects you for one turn if you would die. Broken after use.
Each turn, each of your minions deals [1_holy:holy] damage to a random adjacent enemy
Whenever you cast a [dark] spell, all [undead] allies gain +1 damage for 25 turns.
Each turn, each enemy adjacent to an allied [demon] or [undead] unit takes 2 [fire] damage.
Each turn, each enemy adjacent to an allied [living] unit is poisoned for 3 turns.
Each turn, eat an adjacent wall. Gain 1 HP if you do.
Each turn, consume all adjacent lightning storms. When you do, you regain a charge of your highest level lightning spell of level equal to or less than the number of storms eaten.
Undead allies regenerate 3 HP per turn
Whenever you enter a new level, gain immunity to stun effects for 10 turns.
For every 30 damage dealt to enemies by [enchantments:enchantment], the closest enemy takes 10 fire damage.
When you cast a spell, lose 1 HP and gain 1 [SH:shield].
When you enter a level, turns the nearest enemy spawner or construct into an ally
Your summoned allies deal 6 [Physical] damage to melee attackers
Your summoned allies deal 6 [Poison] damage to melee attackers
Your summoned allies deal 6 [Fire] damage to melee attackers

For every 100 [Dark] damage dealt to enemies, summon a Witch.
Current: 0

For every 300 [Ice] damage dealt to enemies, summon a Yeti.
Current: 0

For every 100 [Fire] damage dealt to enemies, summon a Fire Spirit.
Current: 0
Whenever an enemy dies to [Poison] or [Arcane] damage, deal 9 damage of that type to a random enemy in line of sight of the target up to 5 tiles away.
Whenever an enemy dies to [Ice] or [Dark] damage, deal 9 damage of that type to a random enemy in line of sight of the target up to 5 tiles away.
Whenever an enemy dies to [Holy] or [Lightning] damage, deal 9 damage of that type to a random enemy in line of sight of the target up to 5 tiles away.
Each ally you summon has a one in three chance to be Trollblooded.
Each non-Fire ally you summon has a one in three chance to be Burning.
Each non-Metallic ally you summon has a one in three chance to be Metallic.
Each non-Undead ally you summon has a one in three chance to be Ghostly.

Every 3 turns, the nearest 3 enemy units are afflicted with Poison for 3 turns.
Does not target units already afflicted with Poison.

Every 10 turns, the nearest 7 enemy units are afflicted with Stunned for 3 turns.
Does not target units already afflicted with Stunned.

Every 3 turns, the nearest 2 enemy units are afflicted with Blind for 4 turns.
Does not target units already afflicted with Blind.

Every 6 turns, the nearest 2 enemy units are afflicted with Frozen for 4 turns.
Does not target units already afflicted with Frozen.
Whenever one of your [Arcane] minions dies, it casts your Magic Missile on the killer.
Whenever one of your [Holy] minions dies, it casts your Ghostball on the killer.
Whenever one of your [Demon] minions dies, it casts your Annihilate on the killer.
Whenever one of your [Dragon] minions dies, it casts your Death Shock on the killer.
Each turn, deal 15 Arcane damage to one random enemy currently afflicted with Poison
Each turn, deal 15 Holy damage to one random enemy currently afflicted with Frozen
Whenever an enemy is unfrozen, it is soaked for 3 turns
Poisoned enemies lose one temporary buff each turn.
Enemies receive 3 turns of [poison] when they take [physical] damage.
Casts your Combust Poison for free at the end of each turn.
